primary_reference_modality_cls.definition: Modality with the largest positive Shapley contribution to the full-input predicted-class probability.

dominant_influence_modality_cls.definition: Modality with the largest absolute classification Shapley contribution; its sign may support or oppose the prediction.

dominant_influence_modality_reg.definition: Modality with the largest absolute regression Shapley contribution.

regression.primary_supporting_modality_reg: not_defined_by_frozen_results; do not infer or emit

local_positions.selection: Top positions ranked by absolute importance; retain signed importance.
local_positions.interpretation: A positive signed importance may be called positive local support for the fixed target. A high absolute value alone must not be called support.

mapping_scope.text: verified_text only where C4 verified a WordPiece-to-character span
mapping_scope.audio: index_only unless T4 verifies a speech interval for that same official sequence position
mapping_scope.vision: index_only unless T4 verifies a reconstructed keyframe for that same official sequence position

local_positions.sample_level_status: partial_verified_time or partial_verified_key_positions means only some listed top positions have verified raw evidence; inspect verified/listed position counts and per-position evidence
local_positions.listed_position_count: Unique union of classification and regression top_seq positions for the modality
local_positions.raw_evidence_coverage: At least one verified raw-evidence position among the referenced modality's listed top positions for the relevant target; not complete mapping of every top position

prohibited_claims: audio seconds or key speech evidence without verified T4 mapping
raw visual evidence for sample 13 or 16
